Medium warmed, one vial per group at 08:30 and 13:30. Supervisor at the hood
with the group for the thaw.
Cultures inspected 08:00. Counting chambers or counter ready.
Plates, scrapers. Look at every split before it goes back in the incubator.
Freezing boxes in the -80. Collect all cultures at 17:00. Easter: thaw backup
RAW on Wed 31 Mar, split Fri 2 Apr, so Exp 2 plates can be seeded Mon 5 Apr.
Hoods: 2 groups per half day [TODO: hoods available]. Incubator: one shelf per
Hoods as Mon. Plates: 6-well or 12-well for the growth curve [TODO: lab
-80 freezer box per group; Mr Frosty or equivalent [TODO: lab standard]

Exp 1 is a real experiment: four counts give a growth curve and a doubling time against the published value; viability of your own vial on Mon 5 Apr is the second readout. Easter break Fri 26 Mar to Sun 4 Apr: no course, no cultures.
Facility slot: cytometer, facility lecture (fixed, reserved)
Wet lab Exp 1: establish the line (growth curve, freeze, re-thaw)
Wet lab Exp 2: polarize, challenge, read out
Dry lab and desk work: setup, analysis, planning
Poster and writing: introduction, significance, figures
